questions.question: Meseret cannot attend the national artificial intelligence conference ______ her school principal gives her official permission.
questions.explanation: 'Unless' functions as a subordinating conjunction introducing an adverbial clause of condition meaning 'if... not'.

questions.question: Ongoing technological advances offer promising prospects for higher industrial productivity. What is the closest contextual meaning of 'prospects'?

options.text: Future possibilities or chances for success

questions.explanation: In Section 10D.1 vocabulary, 'prospects' contextually refers to future possibilities, opportunities, or potential for success.

questions.question: The research team had to halt the field test of the autonomous drone because it ______ electrical battery power.
questions.explanation: The phrasal verb 'run out of' means to deplete or exhaust the available supply of a resource.

questions.question: Complete the dialogue: Student: 'What do you think about the software glitch during yesterday's robotics demonstration?' Evaluator: '______; the system froze completely in front of the audience.'

options.text: I couldn't agree more with your success

questions.explanation: 'It was very disappointing' is a standard formal expression used to express dissatisfaction with an outcome or performance.

questions.question: According to the listening text 'Robotics in Ethiopia', which Ethiopian software research center co-developed software for Sophia, the world-famous humanoid robot?
questions.explanation: Section 10A.2 explicitly notes that iCog Labs, a software research center in Ethiopia, was part of the international team that developed software for Sophia.

questions.question: While computer scientists ______ advanced machine learning algorithms at the laboratory right now, traditional systems still rely on basic manual input.
questions.explanation: An action taking place at the present moment of speaking ('right now') requires the Present Progressive tense ('are developing').

questions.question: If local manufacturing plants ______ automated robotic systems, production speed and precision would improve significantly.
questions.explanation: Second Conditional hypothetical clauses use Simple Past ('adopted') in the 'if'-clause paired with 'would + base verb' ('would improve') in the main clause.

questions.question: During the panel discussion on technology, the researchers emphasized that we cannot ______ the possibility of artificial intelligence transforming the future job market.
questions.explanation: The phrasal verb 'rule out' means to exclude, eliminate, or reject a possibility.

questions.question: Which pair of words represents HOMOGRAPHS (words sharing identical spelling but possessing different meanings and pronunciations)?
questions.explanation: 'Wind' (/wɪnd/ = moving air) and 'wind' (/waɪnd/ = to turn or twist) are homographs because they share identical spelling but differ in pronunciation and meaning. Options B, C, and D are homophones.

questions.question: According to the reading text 'The Impact of New Technologies on the Labour Market', why do many economists argue that technological automation will NOT cause permanent mass unemployment?

options.text: Because historical evidence demonstrates that technological waves boost productivity, lower costs, and create new job sectors that did not previously exist.
Because international laws strictly prohibit companies from using robots in factories.
Because artificial intelligence systems are too expensive to operate continuously.
Because low-skilled workers automatically acquire computer programming degrees overnight.

questions.explanation: Section 10C.1 (Paragraph 2) highlights that historically, technological advances have increased overall productivity, raised living standards, and generated more new jobs than they destroyed.

questions.question: In the descriptive phrase 'an Ethiopian artificial intelligence laboratory', what grammatical category does the word 'Ethiopian' belong to?
questions.explanation: Adjectives derived from proper nouns (such as 'Ethiopian' derived from 'Ethiopia') are classified as Proper adjectives.

questions.question: ______ software engineers integrated ethical guidelines into artificial intelligence programming years ago, algorithmic bias would not be such a major social concern today.
questions.explanation: In formal inverted Conditionals linking an unfulfilled past condition to a present result, 'If' is omitted and 'Had' is placed first ('Had software engineers integrated...').

questions.question: Automated diagnostic robots will be deployed in regional hospitals ______ medical staff receive comprehensive operational training.
questions.explanation: 'Provided that' is a subordinating conjunction introducing an adverbial clause of condition meaning 'on condition that' or 'only if'.

questions.question: The computer scientist stated: 'Artificial intelligence is transforming our local agricultural practices.' Which reported speech transformation is grammatically correct for a radio news report?

options.text: The computer scientist stated that artificial intelligence was transforming their local agricultural practices.
The computer scientist stated that artificial intelligence is transforming our local agricultural practices.
The computer scientist stated that artificial intelligence will transform their local agricultural practices.
The computer scientist stated that artificial intelligence had transformed our local agricultural practices.

questions.explanation: In formal report writing using reported speech, present progressive 'is transforming' backshifts to past progressive 'was transforming', and possessive pronoun 'our' shifts to 'their'.

questions.question: In Section 10C.1, what economic phenomenon is described when technological automation increases demand for high-skilled cognitive jobs and low-skilled manual service jobs while reducing middle-skilled routine jobs?
questions.explanation: Section 10C.1 and 10D.1 explicitly define 'labor market polarization' as the structural shift where automation replaces middle-tier routine tasks, expanding opportunities mainly at the high-skill and low-skill ends of the market.
